name: Eiffel Tower Summit
description: Skip the line and ascend straight to the summit for breathtaking panoramic views of Paris sprawling below. The iron lattice tower, built in 1889, is illuminated every night with a dazzling light show.

name: Louvre Museum Tour
description: A guided tour of the world's largest art museum housing over 38,000 works including the Mona Lisa, Venus de Milo, and Winged Victory. An unforgettable journey through art history.

name: Seine River Cruise
description: Glide along the Seine past Notre-Dame, the Louvre, and the Eiffel Tower on a scenic 1-hour boat cruise. Available day and night for different magical experiences.

name: Shibuya Crossing & Hachiko
description: Experience the world's busiest pedestrian crossing where up to 3,000 people cross at once. Visit the loyal Hachiko statue nearby, a beloved symbol of Japanese loyalty.

name: Sushi Making Masterclass
description: Learn authentic sushi-making from a local Michelin-trained master chef. Includes sake pairing, ingredients sourced from Tsukiji market, and a full sit-down meal of your creations.

name: TeamLab Planets Digital Art
description: Walk through breathtaking immersive digital art installations where you become part of the artwork. Floating flowers, crystal worlds, and infinite mirrored universes await.

name: Colosseum Underground Tour
description: Exclusive VIP access to the underground gladiator dungeons, the arena floor, and the top tier viewpoints. Your guide brings 2,000 years of history to life in this legendary amphitheater.

name: Pasta Making with Nonna
description: Learn the secrets of Roman pasta-making from an authentic Italian grandmother in her home kitchen. Make cacio e pepe, carbonara, and fresh tagliatelle from scratch.

name: Vatican Museums & Sistine Chapel
description: An epic journey through the Vatican's art treasures culminating in the awe-inspiring Sistine Chapel, where Michelangelo's ceiling will leave you speechless.

name: Broadway Show
description: Premium orchestra seats for the hottest Broadway production. Experience world-class performances in the Theater District, followed by backstage access with some packages.

name: Central Park Bike Tour
description: Cycle through 843 acres of urban paradise with a local guide. Discover hidden gems, the Bethesda Fountain, Strawberry Fields, and the iconic skyline views from the park.

name: High Line & Chelsea Market Walk
description: Stroll along the iconic elevated park built on a former freight rail line, then explore Chelsea Market's artisan food stalls and boutique shops below.

name: Ubud Rice Terraces Trek
description: Guided sunrise hike through the magnificent UNESCO-listed Tegalalang rice terraces. Learn about traditional Subak irrigation and enjoy fresh coconut water at the top.

name: Uluwatu Sunset & Kecak Dance
description: Watch the sun dip into the Indian Ocean from the clifftop Uluwatu Temple, then witness the hypnotic fire Kecak dance performance, a Balinese tradition rooted in the Ramayana epic.

name: White Water Rafting Ayung River
description: Thrilling class II-III rapids through a stunning jungle gorge on the Ayung River. Includes safety briefing, equipment, and a traditional Balinese lunch at the finish line.

name: Sagrada Família Visit
description: Explore Gaudí's unfinished masterpiece, a UNESCO World Heritage Site under construction since 1882. The towering spires and stunning stained glass create an otherworldly atmosphere.

name: Tapas & Wine Night Tour
description: A guided evening tapas crawl through El Born and the Gothic Quarter. Visit 4 authentic bars chosen by locals, sampling patatas bravas, jamón, croquetas, and regional wines.

name: Barceloneta Beach & Kayak
description: Paddle along Barcelona's stunning coastline with a sea kayak tour. Marvel at the city skyline from the water and discover hidden coves inaccessible from shore.

name: Burj Khalifa At the Top
description: Ascend to the 124th floor observation deck of the world's tallest building for unparalleled views of the Dubai skyline, desert, and Arabian Gulf. Book sunset for the best experience.

name: Desert Safari & BBQ Dinner
description: An exhilarating dune bashing ride in a 4x4, followed by sandboarding, camel riding, henna painting, and a lavish BBQ dinner under the stars at a traditional Bedouin camp.

name: Gold & Spice Souk Walking Tour
description: Explore the glittering Gold Souk — one of the world's largest — and the aromatic Spice Souk. Bargain for saffron, frankincense, and 24-karat treasures in this traditional bazaar.

name: Fushimi Inari Torii Gates Hike
description: Hike through thousands of vibrant vermilion torii gates winding up Mount Inari. Most tourists turn back early — the full hike rewards you with serenity and sweeping forest views.

name: Traditional Tea Ceremony
description: Experience the meditative Japanese tea ceremony (chado) in a 200-year-old machiya townhouse. Learn the philosophy of wabi-sabi while preparing and drinking ceremonial matcha.

name: Arashiyama Bamboo Grove & Monkey Park
description: Walk through the enchanting bamboo grove where towering stalks sway and rustle overhead, then hike to the Iwatayama Monkey Park for panoramic views and playful Japanese macaques.

name: Tower of London Crown Jewels Tour
description: See the actual Crown Jewels — 23,578 gemstones including the Koh-i-Noor diamond — and explore the 1,000-year history of England's most iconic fortress. Yeoman Warder Beefeaters are your guides.

name: Borough Market Food Tour
description: Wander through London's most celebrated food market, sampling artisan cheeses, fresh oysters, gourmet street food, and seasonal produce from around the world. Free to enter — just bring appetite.

name: West End Musical
description: Experience the magic of London's legendary West End theatre district. From Les Misérables to The Phantom of the Opera, world-class productions run seven nights a week.

name: Caldera Sunset Sailing Cruise
description: Sail around the volcanic caldera on a luxury catamaran, stopping to swim in hot springs, snorkel crystal-clear waters, and watch the legendary Santorini sunset with wine and Greek mezedes.

name: Oia Village Photography Walk
description: Wander through the iconic whitewashed village of Oia with its cobalt blue domes and cascading bougainvillea. The most photographed village in the world is free to explore.

name: Inca Citadel Guided Hike
description: A guided exploration of the legendary 15th-century Inca citadel perched at 2,430 meters. Your expert guide reveals the astronomical alignments, agricultural terraces, and stonework that have mystified the world.

name: Opera House Backstage Tour
description: Go behind the scenes of one of the world's most famous buildings. Explore the Concert Hall, Drama Theatre, and discover the engineering secrets of Jørn Utzon's iconic shell design.

name: Bondi to Coogee Coastal Walk
description: Australia's most famous coastal walk stretches 6km along dramatic sea cliffs, hidden beaches, and tidal pools. Free, stunning, and best done at sunrise or late afternoon.

name: NYC Rooftop Bar Hop
description: Visit 3 of New York's best rooftop bars with skyline views — from 230 Fifth's Empire State views to The Top of the Standard's Hudson River panoramas. Guide included.

name: Canal Boat Self-Drive
description: Rent a small electric boat and captain your own journey through Amsterdam's 165 canals. No license needed. Navigate past 17th-century merchant houses, hidden houseboats, and secret gardens.

name: Old Town Ghost Walk
description: A theatrical evening tour of Prague's medieval old town, uncovering dark legends of headless horsemen, ghostly monks, and the Golem of Jewish Quarter. Perfect for Halloween season.
